dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 09, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Reds' Struggles Continue as Nationals Cruise to 7-1 Win**

In a one-sided contest, the Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1 behind a solid team effort. Abimelec Ortiz led the Nationals' offense with a two-hit, one-home run performance, while Will Dion earned the win in relief. The Reds' Brady Singer took the loss, but Brad Lord impressed with 2.2 innings of scoreless relief, striking out four.

**Mets' Bats Explode in 11-1 Rout of Pirates**

The New York Mets' offense exploded for 11 runs, powering a 11-1 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates. A five-hit performance from Luis Robert Jr., including a home run and four RBIs, paced the Mets' attack. Sean Manaea tossed a complete game, striking out 11 and allowing just one earned run.

**Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thriller**

In a back-and-forth contest, the Oakland Athletics edged the Boston Red Sox 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with a three-hit performance, while Brayan Bello pitched well in defeat, striking out four over four innings. Hogan Harris earned the save for the Athletics.

**Brewers Outlast Twins in Walk-Off Fashion**

In a thrilling contest, the Milwaukee Brewers outlasted the Minnesota Twins 4-3. Jake Bauers homered for the Twins, but DL Hall earned the win in relief for the Brewers. A dramatic walk-off was averted when the Twins' challenge was upheld on a play at the plate.

**Rockies Fall to Cardinals in 7-4 Decision**

The St. Louis Cardinals took down the Colorado Rockies 7-4 behind a strong team effort. Hunter Goodman homered for the Rockies, but George Soriano earned the win in relief.
